notes: FAULTLINE v4 "Under Quarantine" balance (M3). Deterministic tactical bot, 150 seeds per keeper (the target's protocol) and 600 seeds per keeper (confidence: a 150-seed win rate moves ±4 points). Every layer on unless named. The v3 baseline is the same engine and bot with every layer off (packs, table front, escalation, designations, surprises, adds). Regression probes, not a human difficulty estimate. Reproduce: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/balance.ts 150 --policy=tactical [--layers=off] [--no-<layer>] [--rule=key:value]. M4 (2026-09-24): Warden Harden scaling (pending approval) and the ascension pass; see `m4`.
policy: Kill order and aiming: every focus, plus for each other port the smallest delivery set that kills it, scored by the forecast (damage weighted toward threat per health, kills by threat, adds before the ultimate, the interrupt, minus incoming, landed disruption and installs). --kill-order=leader keeps the leader focus for the A/B.
A keeper that cannot come within 6 of the break threshold (the fortress line) keeps its deliveries on the guardian and leaves adds to its return fire.

Maintenance: a Phantom Node before any disruption lands; a device the forecast breaks is saved by Field Repair, Redundant PSU or repairs; installations are scrubbed or demolished by value per energy (charges, then Jammers, Spikes, Taps), or the target device steps out of reach when that is cheaper and the forecast loses nothing; a worn primary-route device is repaired; a Server Rack shelters a device that overloads, Spikes or charges would wear.
Hot Patch, Fast Reroute and Link Recovery clear a lingering jam or cut when the forecast gains a channel or 3 damage.

Guardian ultimates: bursts are played only when a greedy sequence on copies reaches the interrupt (aims included); otherwise the line braces. The Ghost buffers on the charge turn (worked example 11.5 C).
Offers: purge a CVE, restore at ≤ 60 % integrity, else reinforce, credit, restore, recover, purge; crate cards by the keeper's reward list.
Warden reward list: Duplex Link, Bulkhead, Sentry Firewall and Quorum added (neutral in the probe).

addBreakBonus.why: The breaking keepers interrupted 76 % (Architect) and 85 % (Ghost) of ultimates at 600 seeds, above the 40–70 % band; +4 per living add brings them to 73 % and 79 % and holds the Architect inside 30–36 % (37 → 36). The Warden braces and is unaffected.

addBreakBonusLate.why: Keeps ascension 10's +1 over the base value (design 11.1: +3, A10 +4).

crateCredits.why: Credits ran +21 % over v3 at the design values (542–560 vs 447–460 per full run). Crates were the largest share: a salvage crate usually rides the last body and falls back to credits, so a crate paid ~5.5 credits instead of the ~3 that 11.4 assumed.

crateFallbackCredits.why: Same: the fallback fired far more often than 11.4 expected.

messageCredits.why: Messages are offered in about a third of pack fights plus every Laden hostile; the credit option dominated.

packHealthScale.why: No win-rate effect beyond noise (±2 at 600 seeds); +0.1–0.2 turns per pack fight. The design's first lever is for a game that plays too easy; this one plays too hard for two keepers.

designationRate.why: No measurable easing: Laden and Salvaged (good designations) are the most common rolls, so fewer designations also removed help (Warden −6 at 150 seeds).

reach.why: Not triggered: stage III maintenance is 5–10 % of energy (target ≤ 10 %, lever at > 15 %).

backpressure split (Warden).value: full release on every attacking port
backpressure split (Warden).why: Not triggered: the Warden survives stage III in 28 % of the runs that reach it (lever at > 42 %).

addHealth.why: Every reduction lifts the Architect as much as the Warden (drone 10: 36/17/30 → 38/19/33); the Architect leaves the band before the Warden gains more than 2–3 points.

wardenFinding.summary: The Warden is the one keeper the numbers cannot place in the band: 42 % in v3, 17 % in v4 (600 seeds), while the Architect sits at 36 % and the Ghost at 30 %. Its losses are guardians: the Hollow Choir (v3 88 % wins, v4 64 %) and the Blackout Core (v3 56 %, v4 33 %), 600 seeds.
wardenFinding.cause: A 7-damage-per-turn fortress line takes 10.6 turns to kill the Choir; adds (two Choristers per charge) absorb ~45 damage per fight between focus and return fire, stretching it to 12.5 turns: a second charge cycle (1.65 ultimates per fight instead of 1.33) and escalation to level 2–3 (jams on two devices lasting two turns against its one or two channels). Integrity lost in the Choir fight: 4.1 (v3) → 7.4 (v4). Without adds the Warden wins 84 % of Choir fights; without escalation 73 %.
wardenFinding.leversTried: Chorister health 10 → 6 (+3 Warden, +3 Architect), Quarantine Drone 14 → 10 (+2, +2), stage I–II escalation start 4 → 7 (+1 with the final line), stage III start 3 → 4 (+1–3 Warden, +8 Ghost), pack health 1.10–1.32 (none), wider channel targets for the bot (worse), reward list with cables (none), fortress targeting (+1).
wardenFinding.suggestion: A keeper-level rule, not a number (for the design owner): e.g. backpressure release that also counts the charge phase, adds raised only on a guardian's first charge, or Harden adding block per living add.
wardenFinding.resolution: M4: Harden +1 block per hostile beyond the first and +1 per guardian add (hardenPerHostile, hardenPerAdd) puts the Warden at 36 % (600 and 1200 seeds) and leaves the others unchanged. Pending the user's approval.

wardenChoice.status: DESIGN ADDITION PENDING THE USER'S APPROVAL
wardenChoice.rule: Harden: gain 2 block, +1 per online firewall, +1 per hostile on the field beyond the first, +1 more per guardian add, and restore 1 condition on your most worn device.
wardenChoice.why: No single key lands in the band: hardenPerHostile 1 gives 27–28 %, 2 gives 38 %; hardenPerAdd 1 gives 23 %, 2 gives 37 % (1200 seeds). Both at 1 give 36 % at 600 and 1200 seeds. The Quorum-like per-hostile term fits section 9.9 (the fortress braces against attackers); the per-add term puts the rest where the Warden's deficit is (guardian charges with adds). Setting both keys to 0 restores the design's Harden.
